findings.finding: The Zvdot4a8i (vector dot product, 4-element, 8-bit integer) extension is not present in the ISA extension string. Only zvbb, zvfh, zvfhmin, zvkt are listed for vector crypto-related extensions. No Zvdot4a8i BitPat definitions, decoder entries, opcodes, or execution unit logic exist anywhere in the repository.
findings.snippet: // Parameters.scala:304 — extension list lacks zvdot4a8i; only zvbb/zvfh/zvfhmin/zvkt present

findings.finding: No BitPat definitions for Zvdot4a8i instructions (e.g., vdot4u.vv, vdot4.vv, vdot4i.vv). Only Zvbb and Zimop BitPats are defined.
findings.snippet: // Instructions.scala:5-22 — only Zvbb, Zimop BitPats defined; no vdot4* BitPats

findings.finding: The vector decoder table maps Zvbb instructions to functional units but contains no entries for Zvdot4a8i instructions (vdot4u.vv, vdot4.vv, vdot4i.vv) across any source operand format (opivv, opivx, opivi, opmvv).
findings.snippet: // VecDecoder.scala:244-440 — decoder has Zvbb entries only; no vdot4 decode logic

findings.finding: The vector integer MAC opcode set (vmul, vmulh, vmacc, vnmsac, vmadd, vnmsub, vsmul) lacks dot-product opcodes needed for Zvdot4a8i. No vdot4u, vdot4, or vdot4i opcode definitions exist.

VimacType defines multiplication and multiply-accumulate operation types (wmul, wmulu, wmulsu, macc, wmaccu, wmacc, etc.) but no dot-product type entries for the 4-element 8-bit integer dot product operations required by Zvdot4a8i.
findings.snippet: // package.scala — VimacType lacks dot-product entries for Zvdot4a8i

findings.finding: The vector integer MAC execution unit directory (VIMac.scala, VIMac64b.scala, etc.) contains no dot-product related datapath logic. No hardware for computing the 4 x 8b → 32b dot product with accumulate exists.
findings.snippet: // vectorIMAC/ — no dot-product datapath; VIMac supports vmul/vmacc/vwmacc only
